context: Daichi takes Ren fishing at the river — two new dads on a guy day.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: れんくん、釣り、ちゃんと、初めてか？
lines.en: Ren-kun, is this really your first time fishing?
lines.style: Bright, forward lean. Kansai warmth unmistakable. Genuine curiosity without pressure—the kind of older-friend question that invites you in. Soft lilt on the ending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ほぼ。子供の頃、親父と、一度だけ。
lines.en: Yeah, basically. My dad took me once when I was a kid.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful. Eyes look inward for the memory. Soft exhale as he speaks—sharing something that still means something. Quiet, genuine pace.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お父さん、思い出すなあ。
lines.en: Ah, your old man. That's coming back to me now.
lines.style: Tender recognition. A slight pause—not awkward, thoughtful. Kansai warmth deepens. His voice settles like he's sitting beside that memory with Ren. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、今日、ここに来たら、すごく、思い出した。
lines.en: Yeah. Coming here today, I've been remembering a lot.
lines.style: Soft and present. Not rushed. A small smile audible underneath. He's speaking to himself as much as to Daichi. Lingering warmth on the trailing thought.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お父さんも、絶対、見てくれてる。釣り、楽しめ。
lines.en: Your dad's definitely watching. Go on—enjoy it.
lines.style: Shift to assurance, but not heavy-handed. Kansai warmth becomes solid, grounded. A hand on the shoulder in the voice. Firm without lecturing. Brief, knowing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Yeah, I'm gonna catch something for sure!
lines.style: Sudden brightening. Quieter conviction breaking through as encouragement lands. Energy gathered up, not loud—genuine. Determination with a small genuine smile underneath.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 魚、釣れたら、家族に、自慢、できるな。
lines.en: You get a catch, you'll be bragging to your whole family about it.
lines.style: Warmth breaks into affectionate teasing. Light, genuine laugh in the voice. Kansai swing obvious now. The kind of easy ribbing that closes a door and opens the next one.
